lines.zh: 牛蹄踏过干草，尘土跟着。
lines.en: Hooves cross dry grass and dust follows.

lines.zh: 我沿着兽群踩出的路走。
lines.en: I walk the trail my herd pressed down.
Do not block me, this body is heavy.

lines.zh: 草丛到我膝盖，正好散步。
lines.en: The grass reaches my knees, good for walking.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但从不让路。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never yield the path.
Horns lowered means I am on my way.
The savanna wind pushes at my flank.

lines.zh: 一头牛也能走出队伍的架势。
lines.en: One bison can walk like a whole herd.

lines.zh: 蹄声闷闷的，像远处的鼓。
lines.en: My hooves sound like distant drums.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草，要很久才直。
lines.en: Grass I step on stays flat a while.
My shadow drags over cracked earth.
My tail flicks flies away.
I chew grass and watch you slowly.
Standing this long makes my legs heavy.

lines.zh: 今天风向不错，适合发呆。
lines.en: Good wind today, fine for doing nothing.

lines.zh: 我把背靠在一棵金合欢上。
lines.en: I lean my back against an acacia.
My tongue sweeps the grass, rustling.
I am in no hurry; neither is the savanna.
Two white puffs leave my nostrils.

lines.zh: 一只椋鸟在我背上歇脚。
lines.en: A starling is resting on my back.
The sun bakes my hide warm.
I count clouds and reach the third.
Do not stand so near, I am resting.
My shadow on the ground is calmer than me.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，又抬起来。
lines.en: I lower my head and raise it again.
This patch of grass lasts all afternoon.

lines.zh: 一只苍蝇落在角上，我甩了甩头。
lines.en: A fly lands on my horn. I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，草屑飞起来。
lines.en: I snort, and bits of grass fly up.

lines.zh: 远处有牛在叫，我抬了下头。
lines.en: A bison calls far off. I lift my head a little.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在同伴的背上。
lines.en: I rest my chin on my herdmate's back.
I lift my eyes, lashes shading the sun.
You are shorter, so you must look up.
Why stare at me? The grass is there.
My eyes show a lot of white, looking fierce.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就收回目光。
lines.en: You step back and I look away.
Do not wave your hands, that means nothing.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，角擦过耳朵。
lines.en: I tilt my head, a horn brushes my ear.

lines.zh: 你袖口沾着麦穗的香气。
lines.en: The smell of wheat clings to your sleeve.
I stare a long time before blinking.

lines.zh: 视线沉甸甸的，像块石头。
lines.en: My gaze is heavy as a stone.
Standing there, you block my wind.

lines.zh: 我只是看看，不代表欢迎。
lines.en: I am only looking, not welcoming.
You dare strike me? Here comes the anger.
Thick hide still hurts; I bellow once.
This arrow sticks in my shoulder.
I shake my head to throw off pain.

lines.zh: 血味让草原安静了一瞬。
lines.en: The smell of blood quiets the savanna.
I step back once and charge again.
Do not think bison forget a grudge.
I paw the dirt, eyes going red.
Pain only makes me want to hit you.
Hit me, but never the calves.

lines.zh: 小麦晃两下，我耳朵就动了。
lines.en: Shake the wheat twice and my ears move.

lines.zh: 你举着麦穗，我慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: You raise wheat and I drift closer.
Do not tease too long, bison get annoyed.
That bundle smells sweet.

lines.zh: 我低头，是为了吃不是服软。
lines.en: I lower my head to eat, not to yield.
Your hand shakes and grain falls.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，只跟这一把。
lines.en: I follow you, but only for that wheat.
Come closer, I can almost reach.
Breeding takes wheat too, convenient.
Once full, I stop looking at you.

lines.zh: 撞上我，像撞一堵带毛的墙。
lines.en: Hitting me is hitting a furry wall.
You bounce off; I barely shift.

lines.zh: 我肩高，正好顶到你胸口。
lines.en: My shoulder height meets your chest.
Do not press from behind, bison startle.

lines.zh: 撞得我脚下的土松了一块。
lines.en: The bump loosened soil under my hooves.
My hide is thick; your hand hurts.

lines.zh: 你踉跄两步，我哼了一声。
lines.en: You stumble twice and I snort.
Squeeze past, but do not push my horns.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，尘土飞起来。
lines.en: We collide and dust rises around us.
Plant your feet and do not blame my weight.

lines.zh: 给我小麦，我就认这门亲。
lines.en: Offer wheat and I accept the match.

lines.zh: 草原上成双的，不止我们。
lines.en: We are not the only pair on the savanna.
Do not crowd us, bison want privacy.

lines.zh: 麦子给够了，我脾气就好。
lines.en: Enough wheat and my temper softens.

lines.zh: 小牛落地几分钟就能走。
lines.en: Calves can walk minutes after dropping.
I touched her horns gently.
This needs a slope without witnesses.

lines.zh: 你手里的麦子别收回去。
lines.en: Do not pull that wheat back now.
Herds are warmer than standing alone.
The calf's coat is softer than mine.
I eat grass straight off the ground.
The leather you dropped is not mine.
I lower my head to crop roots.
Leave things lying; bison do not carry.
My mouth holds only grass and wheat.
Drops belong in your pack.
I stepped over an iron nugget.

lines.zh: 角上挂着草，不是战利品。
lines.en: Grass on my horn is not a trophy.
You gather; I keep grazing.

lines.zh: 我不收藏，草原什么都有。
lines.en: I collect nothing, the savanna has enough.

lines.zh: 你打了我一下，我记住了。
lines.en: You hit me once; I remember.
My nostrils flare and I turn toward you.
Do not run, I lower my head first.
Fifteen seconds is plenty for me.
I fix on you and stop eating.
Horn tips locked onto your direction.
That blow will be returned.
The herd steps back, leaving me.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声低吼，是通知。
lines.en: The low rumble you hear is notice.
I have chosen you; blame the horns.
I break into a trot and the ground shakes.
Circle a tree and I charge the tree.

lines.zh: 牛脾气上来，路线是直的。
lines.en: Bison temper runs in a straight line.
My breathing is rough but steady.

lines.zh: 尘土在我身后拉成一条。
lines.en: Dust trails behind me in a line.
You climb a rock and I circle it.
Fifteen seconds is enough to catch you.
Do not look back, it costs a step.
My horns stay aimed at you.
This savanna is too small for your escape.
One upward toss sends you flying.
That headbutt will keep you down a while.
I paw the dirt, then charge.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头和角碰的声音。
lines.en: You hear bone meet horn.
I swing my head and flip you into grass.
Do not block; bison horns are blunt.
After the hit I am still panting.

lines.zh: 你身上的护甲凹了一块。
lines.en: Your armor now has a dent.
I strike and retreat, anger remains.

lines.zh: 草原上的规矩，用角说话。
lines.en: On this savanna, horns do the talking.

lines.zh: 热带草原的风把我吹来了。
lines.en: The savanna wind carried me in.

lines.zh: 我和同伴一起站在草丛里。
lines.en: I stand with my herd in tall grass.

lines.zh: 这片坡地草够高，我留下。
lines.en: This slope has good grass, I stay.
A low bellow rolls in from far away.

lines.zh: 我从地平线那头慢慢走来。
lines.en: I walk in slowly from the horizon.

lines.zh: 别惊讶，草原本来就该有牛。
lines.en: Do not be surprised, bison belong here.

lines.zh: 金合欢的影子落在我背上。
lines.en: Acacia shade falls across my back.
Every herd has one like me.

lines.zh: 我踩着干草出现，尘土先到。
lines.en: I arrive on dry grass, dust first.

lines.zh: 这地方水草不错，我住了。
lines.en: Water and grass are good here, I settle.

lines.zh: 太阳升起时，我就在这儿。
lines.en: When the sun rose, I was already here.

lines.zh: 你听见蹄声，我已经到了。
lines.en: You hear hooves and I have arrived.

lines.zh: 毛烧焦的味道，比伤口更冲。
lines.en: Burnt hair smells sharper than the wound.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，摔得不轻。
lines.en: I slid down the slope and landed hard.

lines.zh: 牛不擅长游泳，我踩空了。
lines.en: Bison swim poorly; my hooves found no bottom.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻在干草上。
lines.en: The blast flipped me onto the dry grass.

lines.zh: 箭插进厚皮，只进了半寸。
lines.en: The arrow sank only half an inch into hide.

lines.zh: 魔法的光让我毛发竖起。
lines.en: Magic light made my coat stand on end.
The grass ran out and so did my strength.

lines.zh: 雷落在草原上，我惊得直跳。
lines.en: Lightning struck the savanna and I bolted.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，连角都变轻了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, even my horns felt light.
